description: This file defines the Env class which manages environment variables for the application, providing methods to load environment variables from a .env file and access specific configuration values with defaults.

classes.name: Env
classes.description: A class providing static methods and constants to load and access environment variables such as API URLs and mock mode settings.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads environment variables from the .env file, with fallback defaults if loading fails.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: Getter that returns the API base URL, falling back to a default if the environment variable is empty or missing.

methods.name: realtimeUrl
methods.description: Getter that returns the WebSocket URL for real-time communication, with fallback defaults.

methods.name: mockMode
methods.description: Getter that determines whether the app is in mock mode based on environment variable, supporting multiple representations of boolean values.
